actions.name: buille
actions.desc: A plain blow with whatever you hold.

actions.name: liathroid tine
actions.desc: Fireball: hurls fire at a foe for 22 damage, then it burns for 10 more over 4 seconds.

actions.name: sioc
actions.desc: Frost: an icy bolt for 14 damage that roots the foe to the spot for 3 seconds.

actions.name: tintreach
actions.desc: Lightning: strikes a foe and everyone within 6 paces of it for 18, stunning them for a second.

actions.name: mallacht
actions.desc: Curse: a slow rot that drains 30 health from a foe over 10 seconds.

actions.name: sui fola
actions.desc: Blood drain: rips 15 health from a foe and heals you for 12.

actions.name: ceo nimhe
actions.desc: Poison cloud: everything hostile within 9 paces of you takes 24 damage over 6 seconds.

actions.name: codladh
actions.desc: Sleep: the foe cannot move or act for 8 seconds, until something hurts it.

actions.name: leigheas
actions.desc: Heal: mends 35 health on the friend you have targeted, or on you.

actions.name: athbheochan
actions.desc: Renewal: restores 40 health over 10 seconds to a friend, or to you.

actions.name: beannacht
actions.desc: Blessing: heals you and every player within 12 paces for 20.

actions.name: luas
actions.desc: Swiftness: you run 60% faster for 10 seconds.

actions.name: foluain
actions.desc: Levitate: you float above the ground for 6 seconds; blows and spells on the ground pass under you.

moves.say: Crom Dubh breathes out the grave's air!

phases.say: Crom Dubh calls the dead out of the mound!
The dark god rages: the mound fills with poison!

boss.defeat: Crom Dubh falls, and the mound is quiet.

lines: Gee up, there.
Wares from Áth Cliath for Loch Garman.
Bad stretch of road, this, past Cill Dara.
Fair roads to you, traveller.
Barley for Cill Dara, and back with wool.
This wheel wants mending.
God be with you.
To Teamhair, to see where the kings were crowned.
Bless the road and all on it.
My feet will not forgive me.
To Cluain Mhic Nóis, God willing.
A blessing on you, friend.
Keep to the road and you'll keep your purse.
Seen any bandits about?
♪ Oh-ro, welcome home! ♪

♪ Were you at the Rock? ♪

Bread, mead, and a cure for what ails you!
Fresh loaves! Who'll have a loaf?
Mead by the cup, mead by the jug!
Swords from Dublin's best smith, come and see!
Seed for the spring sowing, a penny a bag!
Did you hear about the miller's daughter?
Prices at the market are a scandal.
My back's not what it was.
They say there's weather coming.
Have you seen my goat anywhere?

I told him, I said, not in my field!
Your mother's well, I hope?

Morning! Another day, another penny.
Cold one this morning.

Getting dark. Best be indoors soon.
Wolves will be about tonight.

I don't go past the last house after dark.
Good day to you.

Long day in the field.
The soil's good here, if you work it.
Fine land, this.
You'll want seed from the traders if you've a plot.

Sea's rough today.

Race you to the well!

Have you got a penny?
All's well!
Keep to the streets tonight.
Who goes there? Ah, it's you.
Lantern's low. Long night.
Move along, now.
Trouble? Come to the Watch.
Wolves come close to the walls at night.

Lovely day for it, isn't it?

Keep your distance, friend. And your draughts handy.
Vinegar and prayer. It's all we have.
Bring me any you find with the fever.
Breathe through a cloth, if you must come near.

moves.say: The Brigand King hurls a firepot!

boss.defeat: The Brigand King is down. The camp is yours.

moves.say: The Morrígan's breath turns the cave to frost!

phases.say: The Morrígan screams, and the dead of the cave answer!
Battle-crow and queen: the Morrígan fills the cave with ruin!

boss.defeat: The Morrígan breaks into a storm of crows and is gone. The cave is still.

phases.say: To me, my sworn men! Odin is watching!
The Jarl roars and the cave mouth fills with fire!

boss.defeat: Gofraidh the Jarl falls on his hoard. Dún Mór is yours.

lines: The cows are bawling for me already.
Mist on the low field again.
It's a long way to market from here.
Mind the gate, it sticks.
Not many come up this boreen.
The hay won't save itself.
A traveller! You're a long way from the town.
Stay on the road after dark, friend.
There's an inn on the highway, if you're tired.
God bless the work.
A bed and a hot supper, traveller?
The road's long; rest your feet a while.
Mead's fresh today.
Horses for hire, or for keeps!
Come in, come in! You look half dead from the road.
News from the towns? Sit down and tell it.
Bread, mead and a draught for your wounds.
The forge won't light itself.
Iron's cold this morning.
Hold still, I'm nearly done.
Mind the sparks!
Good iron is hard to come by.
Another horse, another shoe.
Need a blade mended? Or a new one?
Bring me iron, I'll make you a sword.
Troll hide, now, that makes a coat.
Up before the cock to knead the dough.
First loaves are out!
Bread! Fresh bread!
Honey cakes for the children.
Flour's dear this year.
A loaf for the road?
You look thin. Eat something.

The dew's best for picking.
Comfrey, yarrow, a little self-heal.
There's a cure for most things, if you know where to look.
Don't touch that, it's not for eating.
You've a cough on you. Here, take this.
I'll pay for good herbs.
The wisps in the bog lead fools astray.
The sun comes up over the stones.
The birds speak plainly this morning.
Every oak remembers.
Listen. The land is talking.
The old ways are not gone, only quiet.
The Lia Fáil stirs, they say.
Bring me holly and I'll cut you a staff.
The Morrígan watches the crows.
A story for the morning? No, they're for the night.
Did I tell you of Fionn and the salmon?
There was a giant once, under Sliabh na mBan...

Sit, sit. Have you heard of the Fianna?
A tale for a penny, a true one for two.

Matins rung. God keep the day.
Give alms, and it will come back to you.

God bless you, child.

Tracks in the frost. Boar, I'd say.
Out early, the deer are.
Quiet. You'll scare them off.
There's a bear about, I've seen the marks.

Warp and weft, warp and weft.

Hee hee! Catch me if you can!

steps.text: Éist! Longa Lochlannach! Norse longships are landing at Loch Garman!
The Norsemen are beaten back into the sea.

fail_steps.text: The Norsemen sail off with the plunder of Loch Garman.

steps.text: Éist! A Norse fleet rows up the Siúir to Port Láirge!
Port Láirge stands. The longships burn on the strand.

fail_steps.text: The Norse make a longphort of Port Láirge.

steps.text: Éist! Wolves come down out of the wood upon Cill Dara!
The wolves are driven off. Cill Dara sleeps.

fail_steps.text: The wolves slink back into the trees, fed.

steps.text: Éist! Under Brú na Bóinne, Crom Dubh wakes!
Crom Dubh is thrown down into the dark again.

fail_steps.text: Crom Dubh sinks back beneath the mound, unbeaten.

steps.text: Éist! It is fair day in Áth Cliath. Come to the aonach!
A storm blows in off the Atlantic.
Éist! Dawn breaks over Hibernia. The age begins.
Norse longships are sighted off Áth Cliath, Loch Garman and Port Láirge!
To arms! Drive the Norse back into the sea within ten minutes.
The Norse are broken. Hibernia is free, and the High King feasts at Teamhair.

fail_steps.text: The Norse hold the coast. Longphoirt rise where the towns stood.

steps.text: Éist! The host of Crom Dubh marches out of Brú na Bóinne on Ceanannas!
The host is broken on the road to Ceanannas.

fail_steps.text: The host of Crom Dubh burns Ceanannas and melts into the dark.

The Norsemen are beaten back into the sea.

fail_steps.text: The Norsemen sail off with the plunder of Loch Garman.

steps.text: A fog comes up off the bogs with the dawn.
A sea fog rolls in over the land.

quests.name: a new arrival
quests.title: A New Arrival
quests.text: New to these parts? You'll want a trade and a roof before the nights draw in. The Seed Trader at the market in Áth Cliath sets up newcomers. Go and speak to them.
quests.done_text: Good. Tell the Seed Trader the watch sent you.

quests.name: a plot of your own
quests.title: A Plot of Your Own
quests.text: Land first. Type /claim where you stand to make a plot yours. Then press B, pick soil and lay four blocks of tilled earth. Plant the oat seeds in your bag beside it and bring me three sheaves of oats when they ripen.
quests.done_text: Oats! You'll not go hungry now.

quests.name: a roof over your head
quests.title: A Roof Over Your Head
quests.text: Nobody sleeps out in the open with wolves and worse about at night. Build yourself a shelter: walls on three sides and a roof over your head, and the night raiders will pass you by.
quests.done_text: Snug as a monk in his cell.

quests.name: the brigand king
quests.title: The Brigand King
quests.text: The brigands south of Kildare have crowned themselves a king. Their camp gives every company that walks in a fight of its own. Don't go alone: gather a party (the Invite button over a player, or /invite Name) and bring him down.
quests.done_text: The roads will be safer for it. Take this blade; you've earned it.

quests.name: wolves at the fold
quests.title: Wolves at the Fold
quests.text: The wolves have taken three lambs this week. Drive them off before they take the rest: kill five of them, and I'll see you're fed.
quests.done_text: The flock is quiet tonight. Take this, and my thanks.

quests.name: pelts for the winter
quests.title: Pelts for the Winter
quests.text: Winter is coming hard. Bring me four wolf pelts and the children will sleep warm.
quests.done_text: Fine pelts. The little ones will thank you.

quests.name: deer for the pot
quests.title: Deer for the Pot
quests.text: The harvest was thin. Hunt three deer from the woods and the village eats this week.
quests.done_text: Venison! We'll eat well. Come back if you're passing again.

quests.name: the road to glendalough
quests.title: The Road to Gleann Dá Loch
quests.text: Brother Ciarán has not written from Gleann Dá Loch in a month. Walk there, see that all is well, and come back to me.
quests.done_text: He is well? God be thanked. You have a good heart.

quests.name: relics of the saints
quests.title: Relics of the Saints
quests.text: Brigands robbed a pilgrim of the abbey's silver. Take back five silver pennies from them, and bring them to me.
quests.done_text: The abbey's silver, returned. Your name goes in our prayers.

quests.name: brigands on the road
quests.title: Brigands on the Road
quests.text: Brigands rob anyone on the road south. Find their camp and put four of them in the ground.
quests.done_text: The road is safer for it. You fight like one of the Fianna.

quests.name: word to the merchant
quests.title: Word to the Merchant
quests.text: Tell the merchants the south road is open again. Find a merchant and give them the word.
quests.done_text: Good news travels fast with you.

quests.name: the fishers worry
quests.title: The Fisher's Worry
quests.text: Strange lights on Loch nEathach at night. Go and look, and come back and tell me what you saw.
quests.done_text: Only marsh-fire? Well, I'll sleep easier.

quests.name: the restless dead
quests.title: The Restless Dead
quests.text: The sluagh rise from Brú na Bóinne and walk the land at night. Go to the mound and lay four of them to rest.
quests.done_text: The dead sleep again. You have done holy work.

quests.name: the hill of tara
quests.title: The Hill of Tara
quests.text: The High King asks for fighters. Go to Teamhair, then find a monk to bless your road.
quests.done_text: The King will hear your name.

quests.name: the first furrow
quests.title: The First Furrow
quests.text: Grow me three sheaves of wheat. Buy wheat seed from me, lay soil in build mode (B, then \), plant the seed beside it, and break the ripe crop to bring it in.
quests.done_text: Good wheat. You have the knack of it.

quests.name: oats for the horses
quests.title: Oats for the Horses
quests.text: The carters’ horses are hungry. Six sheaves of oats, if you can grow them.
quests.done_text: They will eat well tonight.

quests.name: carrots for the fair
quests.title: Carrots for the Fair
quests.text: The fair is coming and I have nothing fresh to sell. Bring me five carrots.
quests.done_text: Fine carrots. Here is your share.

quests.name: a cabbage for the abbot
quests.title: A Cabbage for the Abbot
quests.text: The abbot has a fondness for cabbage, and our garden failed. Two heads, grown by your own hand.
quests.done_text: He will be pleased. Bless you.

quests.name: a hunters living
quests.title: A Hunter's Living
quests.text: There is always a market for venison. Three deer, and I will pay.
quests.done_text: Fair pay for fair work.

quests.name: pelts for coin
quests.title: Pelts for Coin
quests.text: Wolf pelts keep a shepherd warm. Three more, whenever you have them.
quests.done_text: Warm nights ahead.

quests.name: the robbers pass
quests.title: The Robbers' Pass
quests.text: Robbers hold the pass at Bealach na gCreach. Go there and drive three of them off.
quests.done_text: The road is safer for it.

quests.name: white wolves of the north
quests.title: White Wolves of the North
quests.text: White wolves are coming down out of the snowy north. Go up there and thin them out: five will do.
quests.done_text: You have the north in your bones now.

quests.name: a pilgrims way
quests.title: A Pilgrim's Way
quests.text: Walk the holy road with me in spirit: Gleann Dá Loch, Cluain Mhic Nóis and the Rock of Caiseal.
quests.done_text: You have walked where the saints walked.

quests.name: the holy well
quests.title: The Holy Well
quests.text: Drink at Tobar Bríde, then tell a monk you have been.
quests.done_text: The well remembers you.

quests.name: news from the coast
quests.title: News from the Coast
quests.text: Go down the coast to Port Láirge and Corcaigh, see how the boats fare, and bring the news to a trader in Áth Cliath.
quests.done_text: So the boats are safe. Good.

quests.name: the four provinces
quests.title: The Four Provinces
quests.text: A merchant should know the country. See Gaillimh, Luimneach, Doire and Ard Mhacha, and you will know it too.
quests.done_text: Now you know Ireland.

quests.name: the shepherds errand
quests.title: The Shepherd's Errand
quests.text: Go to Áth Cliath and ask a seed trader if they have any seed to spare for a shepherd.
quests.done_text: Seed for the spring. Thank you.

quests.name: the northmen
quests.title: The Northmen
quests.text: When the longships come, stand with us. Beat three of the raiders.
quests.done_text: They will think twice before coming again.

quests.name: the watchs bounty
quests.title: The Watch's Bounty
quests.text: The watch pays a bounty on wolves taken near the roads. Six pelts' worth of trouble, and the coin is yours. Come back tomorrow and there'll be more.
quests.done_text: Six fewer wolves. Here's your bounty.

quests.name: bread for the poor
quests.title: Bread for the Poor
quests.text: The poor come to the abbey door every morning. Bring us three loaves and we'll see they're fed.
quests.done_text: God keep you. They'll eat tonight.

quests.name: the brigand toll
quests.title: The Brigand Toll
quests.text: The brigands take a toll off every cart on the road. Take one off them: five of their number, and the roads are ours for the day.
quests.done_text: That'll quiet them till morning.

quests.name: the stone cries out
quests.title: The Stone of Destiny
quests.text: They say the Lia Fáil on the Hill of Tara has fallen silent: the stone that roars beneath a true king. Go to Tara and see it for yourself.
quests.done_text: Silent, you say? Then something is badly wrong in Ireland.
quests.opening:
The Stone of Destiny
On the Hill of Tara, the Lia Fáil has fallen silent.

quests.name: the monks of kells
quests.title: The Monks of Kells
quests.text: The monks keep the old books. If anyone knows why the stone is quiet, it's them. Find a monk and ask.
quests.done_text: The stone? Yes. We have feared this. Sit, and I will tell you.

quests.name: words in the book
quests.title: Words in the Book
quests.text: The old book says the stone sleeps when the dark god walks again. The brothers at Clonmacnoise and Glendalough watch the old roads; go to both and see what stirs.
quests.done_text: Graves opened at both? Then it is as the book says.
quests.opening:
Words in the Book
"When Crom Dubh walks, the stone will sleep."

quests.name: the restless mound
quests.title: The Restless Mound
quests.text: The dead walk out of Brú na Bóinne at night, the sluagh, his host. Thin them, before they reach the towns.
quests.done_text: The host is thinner. But he is still in his mound.

quests.name: the dark god
quests.title: The Dark God
quests.text: Crom Dubh waits in the mound at Brú na Bóinne. No one goes in alone and comes out. Gather a company (the group finder will find you one) and end him.
quests.done_text: You did it. Go to Tara, quickly. I think the stone is waking.
quests.opening:
The Dark God
Beneath Brú na Bóinne, Crom Dubh waits for you.
quests.closing:
Crom Dubh falls
And far off, on the Hill of Tara, something stirs.

quests.name: the stone speaks
quests.title: The Stone Speaks
quests.text: Stand by the Lia Fáil on Tara, and then tell the arms trader in Áth Cliath what you heard.
quests.done_text: It roared? Then there's a true heart in Ireland yet. Take this; you've earned more than gold.
quests.opening:
The Stone Speaks
The Lia Fáil roars beneath your feet.
quests.closing:
The Stone of Destiny
The stone has spoken. Ireland will remember your name.

quests.name: ore for the forge
quests.title: Ore for the Forge
quests.text: The forge eats iron faster than the carters bring it. The kern up in the hills carry ore they've robbed off the miners. Bring me six lumps, from them or anywhere.
quests.done_text: Good ore. You'll make a smith yet.

quests.name: the smiths apprentice
quests.title: The Smith's Apprentice
quests.text: Smelt it yourself this time: two ore and a lump of charcoal make a bar. Charcoal is two of timber. Bring me three bars and I'll show you a sword.
quests.done_text: Clean bars. Here, make yourself a blade.

quests.name: hides for a coat
quests.title: Hides for a Coat
quests.text: A troll's hide turns a blade like nothing else. The hill trolls on Sliabh Speirín wear the best of it. Bring me three.
quests.done_text: Thick as a door. I'll have a coat out of this.

quests.name: scales of the wyrm
quests.title: Scales of the Wyrm
quests.text: Now, there's a thing I've only heard of: a hauberk of wyrm scale. The péist in the great lochs sheds them. Four, and I'll make it.
quests.done_text: Green as the sea and hard as stone. Wear it well.

quests.name: the answerer
quests.title: The Answerer
quests.text: There was a sword once, Fragarach, that no armour could stop. Manannán's own. Bring me the heart of Crom Dubh and the tooth of a great wyrm, and I'll try to make it again.
quests.done_text: It answers. God help whoever asks it a question.

quests.name: holly for a staff
quests.title: Holly for a Staff
quests.text: Holly keeps its leaves when the oak gives up. Cut me four branches: the shroomlings in Coill na Mac Tíre guard the best of it.
quests.done_text: Holly. Good. The staff will remember who cut it.

quests.name: the crows of the morrigan
quests.title: The Crows of the Morrígan
quests.text: The Morrígan's crows are thick over Cruachan. Bring me six raven feathers, and I'll read what they say.
quests.done_text: They say she is waking. That is not good news.

quests.name: the stone that roars
quests.title: The Stone That Roars
quests.text: The Lia Fáil is silent because the old powers are loose. Crom Dubh in his mound, the Morrígan in her cave. Bring me something of each, and I'll wake the stone.
quests.done_text: It roars again. Ireland has a king, whether it knows it or not.

quests.name: the sidhe at the door
quests.title: The Sídhe at the Door
quests.text: The bean sí keen at the old forts at night. One sings for every death. Silence three of them, before they sing for you.
quests.done_text: Quiet. For now.

quests.name: the salmon of knowledge
quests.title: The Salmon of Knowledge
quests.text: Fionn burnt his thumb on the Salmon of Knowledge and knew everything after. I'm not asking for that one. Any salmon will do: bring me two, and I'll tell you the rest.
quests.done_text: ...and that's why he sucked his thumb before every battle. Thank you, child.

quests.name: the hill of allen
quests.title: The Hill of Allen
quests.text: The Fianna gathered at Almhain. Walk to Teamhair, then to Dún Ailinne, and you'll have walked where they walked.
quests.done_text: You've the feet of a fénnid, I'll say that.

quests.name: oisin in the west
quests.title: Oisín in the West
quests.text: Oisín went west to Tír na nÓg, they say, from the cliffs past Gaillimh. Go and look out to sea from there, and tell me if you see it.
quests.done_text: You saw nothing? Then you looked right. It isn't for seeing.

quests.name: the giant under the mountain
quests.title: The Giant Under the Mountain
quests.text: Fionn fought a gruagach under Earagail, a great hairy brute who stole cattle. There are still some of them up there. Bring me proof one fell.
quests.done_text: A gruagach! My own grandfather never saw one. You're in my next story.

quests.name: the headless rider
quests.title: The Headless Rider
quests.text: Nobody likes this one. A rider with his head under his arm, who says your name and you die. They ride the black passes. If you'll stop one, I'll stop telling it.
quests.done_text: Then I'll tell a new one, with you in it.

quests.name: herbs for the sick
quests.title: Herbs for the Sick
quests.text: Half the village is coughing. Bring me eight bundles of herbs: the frogs in the lochs and the shroomlings both carry them.
quests.done_text: That'll do them. God bless you.

quests.name: honey for the cure
quests.title: Honey for the Cure
quests.text: The greater draught wants honey. The bakers keep it. Two jars, and I'll show you the brew.
quests.done_text: Sweet as anything. Here, carry a few.

quests.name: the wisps of the bog
quests.title: The Wisps of the Bog
quests.text: Lights over the loch at night, leading folk into the water. Put out six of them.
quests.done_text: No more drownings, please God.

quests.name: silk for the stitching
quests.title: Silk for the Stitching
quests.text: Spider silk closes a wound better than gut. The great spiders in the caves spin it. Four threads.
quests.done_text: Strong and fine. You've saved a life with that, somewhere.

quests.name: hare today
quests.title: Hare Today
quests.text: There's a fox has been taking my snares. Take six hares before it does, and bring me the meat.
quests.done_text: Good shooting. We'll eat tonight.

quests.name: the badger sett
quests.title: The Badger Sett
quests.text: Badgers under the hedges, and the hedges falling down. Bring me four pelts and I'll make you a jerkin.
quests.done_text: Fine pelts. Here's your jerkin.

quests.name: the bear of the wood
quests.title: The Bear of the Wood
quests.text: A bear has come down out of the hills and killed a cow. Bring it down. Two of its pelts, if there's more than one.
quests.done_text: Two pelts. There'll be a fur coat out of these.

quests.name: the bull in the low field
quests.title: The Bull in the Low Field
quests.text: The wild bulls are worse than any wolf. Bring three of them down and bring me their horns.
quests.done_text: Horns like that, a smith will pay well. Keep one.

quests.name: the huntsmans bow
quests.title: The Huntsman's Bow
quests.text: There's a crossbow in the old stories that never missed. I can make one, with a wyrm's tooth for the nut and spider silk for the string.
quests.done_text: There. It won't miss, if you don't.

quests.name: flour for the oven
quests.title: Flour for the Oven
quests.text: The miller's late again. Bring me six sheaves of wheat and I'll bake for the whole street.
quests.done_text: Smell that! Take a loaf or three.

quests.name: eggs and honey
quests.title: Eggs and Honey
quests.text: For the honey cakes: three eggs from the farms, and a jar of honey.
quests.done_text: There's your cake. Don't eat it all at once.

quests.name: the millers wheel
quests.title: The Miller's Wheel
quests.text: Something stops my wheel every night: a little red man, laughing. The far darrig. Catch three and they'll leave me be.
quests.done_text: Turning all night, and not a laugh. Thank you.

quests.name: grist for the mill
quests.title: Grist for the Mill
quests.text: Bring me oats, ten sheaves, and I'll grind them for the baker. She pays me in cake.
quests.done_text: She'll pay you in cake too, if you ask.

quests.name: wool from the hills
quests.title: Wool from the Hills
quests.text: Five fleeces from the farms. The sheep won't mind, much.
quests.done_text: Lovely and soft. Here, a tunic for your trouble.

quests.name: the royal purple
quests.title: The Royal Purple
quests.text: Purple is for kings. I can make it, with spider silk and a gold piece. Bring me both.
quests.done_text: There. Fit for a king. Or you.

quests.name: a pot to mend
quests.title: A Pot to Mend
quests.text: I need a little iron for the mending. Two bars, and I'll give you a brooch I found on the road.
quests.done_text: Found on the road, I said. Don't ask where.

quests.name: the leprechauns gold
quests.title: The Leprechaun's Gold
quests.text: Little green fellows with pots of gold, in the woods by the lochs. Catch me two and I'll split the gold with you.
quests.done_text: Not a pot. A few coins. Still! Here's your half.

quests.name: the long road
quests.title: The Long Road
quests.text: I'll tell you where I've been: Doire, Béal Feirste, Corcaigh, Trá Lí. You go and see if I'm lying.
quests.done_text: Told you. Have this, it's a fine pony.

quests.name: candles for the dead
quests.title: Candles for the Dead
quests.text: The dead are restless at Brú na Bóinne. Lay them to rest: ten of the sluagh.
quests.done_text: May they sleep now.

quests.name: the black passes
quests.title: The Black Passes
quests.text: Pilgrims won't take the road through Bealach na gCreach since the kern came. Clear eight of them out.
quests.done_text: The pilgrims will pray for you.

quests.name: the puca
quests.title: The Púca
quests.text: A black horse with yellow eyes, carrying folk off at night. They call it the púca. Bring three down.
quests.done_text: Three fewer to fear. You're a brave one.

quests.name: cattle raiders
quests.title: Cattle Raiders
quests.text: Raiders down out of the mountains, running off whole herds. Ten of them, and the herds come home.
quests.done_text: The farmers will drink to you tonight.

quests.name: the fomorian champion
quests.title: The Fomorian Champion
quests.text: The Fomorians have a champion in the north, twice the size of the rest. Bring him down, and bring back a bone of him.
quests.done_text: Like a tree trunk! Ireland's a little safer.

quests.name: north wind
quests.title: North Wind
quests.text: Snow trolls coming down further every winter. Twelve of them, before they reach the farms.
quests.done_text: Twelve! The north will be quieter.

quests.name: the wolves of winter
quests.title: The Wolves of Winter
quests.text: White wolves out of the north, bolder every week. Twenty of them.
quests.done_text: That'll keep them back a season.

quests.name: trollhunter
quests.title: Trollhunter
quests.text: I pay by the hide. Any troll. Bring me what you can.
quests.done_text: Good hides. Here's your pay.

quests.name: supplies for waterford
quests.title: Supplies for Port Láirge
quests.text: Port Láirge is short this season. Carry five of cais there and see the market stocked.
quests.done_text: Stocked, and the price come down. Well done.

quests.name: the road to cork
quests.title: The Road to Corcaigh
quests.text: Travellers to Corcaigh keep coming back hurt, or not at all. Clear the road: eight of what's out there, and go and see the town safe.
quests.done_text: The road's open. The carters will thank you.

quests.title: Word to Inis
quests.text: There's news for Inis that won't keep. Walk to Luimneach, then on to Inis, and tell them what you've seen on the road.
quests.done_text: That's the word carried. They'll be glad of it.

rewards.text: Level 2: five silver pennies to spend.
Level 3: healing drinks, and cabbage seed for the garden.
Level 5: a sword of your own.
Level 7: twenty pennies and drink for the road.
Level 15: a gold ring, and a purse.

classes.name: ridire
classes.title: Ridire (Knight)
classes.desc: A sworn knight in mail: hard to bring down, and blessed with healing. Stands in front so others need not.

classes.name: laoch
classes.title: Laoch (Warrior)
classes.desc: A warrior of the Fianna: the hardest blows in Hibernia, and the strength to drain a foe and leap clear.

classes.name: draoi
classes.title: Draoi (Druid)
classes.desc: A druid of the old ways: fire, frost, storm and curse, sleep for the wary, and renewal for friends.

classes.name: ceithearnach
classes.title: Ceithearnach (Kern)
classes.desc: A light-footed kern: swift, poisonous and patient, putting foes to sleep before the knife.

achievements.name: crom dubh
achievements.title: Darkness Ended
achievements.text: Crom Dubh, beaten in his mound.
